accepted_findings.issue: Path aliases normalize before canonical check but raw strings drive uniqueness
accepted_findings.verification: Path removes redundant slash/dot components; two raw strings could designate one file
accepted_findings.fix: Require exact canonical string spelling before opening; track canonical body paths. Apply same invariant to source roots, runtime/child paths and exclusive output directory
accepted_findings.regressions: Invented duplicate body aliases, literal path aliases and aliased source roots
